description.zh:
接收语音通知的被叫号码。

号码格式：
- 手机号码。示例：159****0000。
- 固话号码。示例：0571****5678。
> - 调用一次接口仅支持添加一个被叫号码。如果有多个被叫号码，可以多次调用。
> - 同一个**资质信息+号码用途**，拨打每一个被叫号码的频次有流控限制：1次/分钟、5次/小时、20次/24小时。 流控规则计时从第一次正常外呼开始，超过这个频率就会触发流控。呼叫成功或失败都会消耗一次流控频率。
> - 如**使用专属模式**调用此接口且您的业务需要更宽松的流控频率，您可至[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)--通用设置--呼叫设置--呼出流控-频次中，尝试**申请调整流控次数**，**公共模式不支持**。
description.en:
The number for receiving voice notifications.

Number format:

*   In the Chinese mainland:

    *   Mobile phone number, for example, 159\*\*\*\*0000.
    *   Landline number, for example, 0571\*\*\*\*5678.

*   Outside the Chinese mainland: country code + phone number, for example, 85200\*\*\*\*00.

> 

*   You can specify only one called number for a request. For more information, see [How to use voice notifications in the Chinese mainland](~~150016~~) or [How to use voice notifications in regions outside the Chinese mainland](~~268810~~).

*   Voice notifications are sent to a called number at the following frequency: one time per minute, five times per hour, and 20 times per 24 hours.

description.zh:
发送语音通知的通话号码（被叫显号）。若此参数不填，则为公共模式通话；若传入真实号或服务实例ID，则为专属模式通话。

- 如果您使用公共模式通话，该参数不填。将由系统随机调度使用公共号码池内的号码通话。
- 如果您使用专属模式通话，请传入您的**真实号码**或**服务实例ID**。
您可以登录[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)，在**真实号管理**页面查看已购买的**真实号**，在**服务实例管理**页面查看已创建并绑定真实号的**服务实例**。
description.en:
The number displayed to the called party.

*   You do not need to specify this parameter if you use a voice notification file that uses the common outbound call mode. For more information, see [FAQ about the common outbound call mode](~~172104~~).
*   If you use a voice notification file that uses the dedicated outbound call mode, you must specify a number that you purchased. You can specify only one number. You can log on to the [Voice Messaging Service console](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home) and choose **Real Number Service** > **Real Number Management** to view the number that you purchased.

description.zh:
预留给调用方的ID，最终会通过回执消息将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度限制为1~15个字符。
description.en:
The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in a receipt message.

The value must be of the STRING type and 1 to 15 bytes in length.

description.zh: 语音通知文件的播放次数。取值范围：**1~3**。
description.en: The number of times the voice notification file is played. Valid values: 1 to 3.

description.zh: 语音文件播放的语速。取值范围：**-500~500**。
description.en: The playback speed of the voice notification file. Valid values: -500 to 500.

description.zh:
语音通知文件的语音ID。传入的语音ID的外呼模式类型应与CalledShowNumber匹配。

您可登录[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)在以下页面获取语音ID，该语音通知文件必须已审核通过。

- 在**语音消息**>**语音通知**>**语音通知文件**页面获取**语音ID**。

- 在**语音文件管理**>**语音通知文件**页面获取**语音ID**。
description.en:
The voice ID of the voice notification file.

You can log on to the [Voice Messaging Service console](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home), choose **Voice Messages** > **Voice Notifications** or **Voice File Management**, and then click the **Voice Notification Files** tab to view the **voice ID**.

description.zh: 语音通知文件播放的音量。取值范围：**0~100**，默认取值**100**。
description.en: The playback volume of the voice notification file. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100.

title.zh: 发送语音通知文件类型的语音通知

descriptions.zh:
- 请在使用该接口前，了解语音服务套餐包及功能计费，详情请参见[国内语音服务定价](~~150083~~)。

- 语音文件公共模式和专属模式不通用，如果您使用公共模式调用本接口，请在**导入语音文件时外呼号码选择公共模式外呼**，专属模式同理。

- 语音通知文件不支持变量参数，如您需要发送带变量的语音通知，请至[语音服务控制台](https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/notify/addt2v)申请**文本转语音模板**后使用[SingleCallByTts](~~393519~~)接口。

- 如果需要批量发送语音任务，请使用[CreateCallTask](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.12771c4esA3Fbv)接口创建语音任务（创建语音任务仅限专属模式且需使用服务实例调用）。


### QPS限制
单用户调用频率：1200次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> Due to business adjustments, the updates of the voice notification and voice verification code services have been stopped in regions outside the Chinese mainland and the services have been discontinued since March 2022. Only qualified customers can continue using the voice notification and voice verification code services.

You can call the [SingleCallByTts](~~393519~~) operation to send voice notifications with variables.

### QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 1,200 times per second per account.
